property_summary: For any role and account, hasRole must report exactly the stored membership (true iff the account was granted that role, e.g. the deployer and the contract hold TIMELOCK_ADMIN_ROLE, everyone else does not); the mutant inverts the lookup so every query returns the opposite, breaking the rule for any account.
